mechanism: Allopurinol increases ampicillin/amoxicillin rash incidence; penicillin V may increase allopurinol levels by reducing renal clearance via competition for tubular secretion.
action: Monitor for increased rash risk if ampicillin-class penicillins used with allopurinol; penicillin V is safer alternative but counsel patient on rash signs; ensure adequate renal function monitoring.
